title: Document the stamp-superseded audit value in the strictReadonlyWrites contract jsdoc
body:
domain:server#2 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufziCTpjnYbdh76SAWwb

Origin: nit 2 of the delta contract review on PR #32338 (card #32278).

`WriteObservabilityOptions.strictReadonlyWrites` in `packages/spec/src/contracts/data-engine.ts` documents the equal-value exemption for `stored_expression`. It says nothing about the audit-provenance value the stamp supersedes on a create (`created_by`, `created_at`, `updated_by`, `updated_at`): that it is reported under `readonly`, refused under strict, and admitted when equal to the stamp. Today only `content/docs/kernel/contracts/data-engine.mdx` and the #32338 changeset say so. The coverage sentence already governs, so the contract is not false, just incomplete.

Premise re-check: `git grep -n "stored_expression" -- packages/spec/src/contracts/data-engine.ts` lists the exemption sentence, and `git grep -n "created_by\|AUDIT_PROVENANCE" -- packages/spec/src/contracts/data-engine.ts` finds no audit sentence.

Wanted: one jsdoc paragraph beside the `stored_expression` one. Comment only, no type change.

Clause-②: no
